name: SunPass (Florida's Turnpike Enterprise) and Toll-By-Plate invoices
notes: Researched from the public SunPass User Manual PDF (revised November 2025). sunpass.com HTML pages sit behind a bot check that was not bypassed, so login wording, close-account steps and FAQ details were not read this session and keep the family/catalog defaults. Easy Pay links a credit/debit card or bank account and adds a preset amount when the balance gets low; activation needs a $10 minimum balance. Funds can also be added manually online, with cash at authorized retailers, by phone at 1-888-TOLL-FLA or in person. Activity is free online; mailed monthly statements cost a fee (amount not stated in the manual). Transponders: SunPass Mini $4.99 + tax, SunPass PRO $14.95 + tax. Toll-By-Plate: a Toll Enforcement Invoice to the first registered owner with a $2.50 administrative charge per invoice; unpaid tolls can bring collections or a vehicle registration hold. Reviewer (2026-10-09): sunpass.com still serves a bot check; facts re-confirmed on Florida's Turnpike Enterprise pages (operator of SunPass, added to officialDomains): Easy Pay links a credit card, debit card or bank account (ACH); Mini $4.99 and PRO $14.95 plus tax; TOLL-BY-PLATE $2.50 administrative fee per invoice; the TOLL-BY-PLATE page links to 'Pay a Toll Invoice'. Reviewer (2026-10-09, run 2): the catalog's synthetic 3/6/12-month online payment plan was removed (payment_arrangement unsupported, evidence inferred): no official page read, nor a web search, describes an installment plan for this agency, so the mock now points to customer service instead.

autopay.note: Easy Pay adds a preset amount from your saved card or bank account when the balance gets low.

paperless.note: Account activity is free online; monthly statements by mail cost a fee.

guest_pay.note: TOLL-BY-PLATE invoices are paid online with Pay a Toll Invoice; no SunPass account is needed.

help.title: SunPass Easy Pay
paragraphs: Easy Pay is the simplest way to keep money in your prepaid SunPass account. It links a credit card, debit card or bank account, and when the balance gets low a preset amount is added automatically from that saved method.
Enrolling in Easy Pay also makes you a SunPass Plus customer, so you can pay for parking at participating Florida airports and facilities.
You must keep a positive balance for your transponder to stay active; activation requires at least $10 on the account.

help.title: Adding funds to your account
paragraphs: Sign in and use a credit/debit card or bank account to add funds whenever you like; funds are available right away if the account is active.

Add cash at thousands of authorized retail locations across Florida with no card or bank details, call 1-888-TOLL-FLA (1-888-865-5352) to add funds by phone, or visit a walk-in center. Keeping an eye on your balance is your responsibility.

help.title: SunPass Mini and SunPass PRO
paragraphs: Opening an account means buying, activating and installing a transponder. The SunPass Mini costs $4.99 plus tax and works in Florida, Georgia, Kansas, North Carolina, Oklahoma and Texas. The SunPass PRO costs $14.95 plus tax, moves between cars and also works wherever E-ZPass is accepted.
To activate you need the transponder ID number, your license plate number and payment information.

help.title: TOLL-BY-PLATE and unpaid tolls
paragraphs: Without an active transponder, TOLL-BY-PLATE photographs the plate and mails the registered owner an invoice covering about 30 days of tolls plus a $2.50 administrative charge per invoice. Pay it online with Pay a Toll Invoice.
Not paying for a Florida toll facility can lead to referral to a collection agency or a hold on the vehicle's registration.
TOLL-BY-PLATE does not work in Florida managed (express) lanes, which need a transponder. Florida's Turnpike says SunPass customers save about 25% on average compared with TOLL-BY-PLATE.

help.title: Transaction activity and statements
paragraphs: Every toll, replenishment, purchase and adjustment shows on your SunPass account. Viewing it online is free; monthly statements by mail are available for a fee.
Customer service: 1-888-TOLL-FLA (1-888-865-5352), Monday to Friday 7 AM to 7 PM and Saturday 8:30 AM to 5 PM, closed Sundays.

extra.intent: Using the SunPass website's help pages, find the administrative charge added to each TOLL-BY-PLATE Toll Enforcement Invoice. Do not make a payment or change any settings.
